2608.23284.title: Dynamic Topic Modeling for Cross-Corpus Temporal Analysis
2608.23284.paper_summary: Dynamic Embedded Topic Models (D-ETM) provide an interpretable framework for modeling temporal semantic evolution, but cross-corpus comparison remains difficult because topics are often learned independently and aligned only after training, a process that does not guarantee stable topic correspondence across corpora and time. To address this problem, we propose a D-ETM framework that first learns a common dynamic topic space over a merged multi-corpus collection, which we call the shared backbone, then introduces corpus-specific residual adaptation around the frozen backbone without creating separate latent topic spaces. This design preserves a shared topic index for cross-corpus comparison while allowing each corpus to specialize lexically. We evaluate the framework on three temporally structured corpora spanning 97 years: the Corpus of Historical American English, Harvard Business Review, and International Labour Review. Residual adaptation improves corpus-specific fit relative to the shared backbone while preserving the same-index cross-corpus topic trajectories, achieving substantially stronger alignment than full fine-tuning from the same backbone, with $97.5 \pm 0.7\%$ versus $17.9 \pm 1.1\%$ trajectory Retrieval@1, as well as stronger alignment than independent training with post-hoc Hungarian matching. These results suggest that incorporating topic alignment into the model can support more stable over-time cross-corpus comparisons while retaining corpus-specific lexical variation.
2608.23284.paper_summary_zh: 動態嵌入主題模型（D-ETM）提供了一個可解釋的框架，用於建模時間語義演變，但跨語料庫比較仍然困難，因為主題通常是獨立學習的，並且僅在訓練後對齊，這一過程並不能保證跨語料庫和時間的穩定主題對應。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個D-ETM框架，首先在合併的多語料庫集合上學習一個共同的動態主題空間，我們稱之為共享骨幹，然後在凍結的骨幹周圍引入語料庫特定的殘差適應，而不創建單獨的潛在主題空間。這一設計保留了一個共享的主題索引，以便進行跨語料庫比較，同時允許每個語料庫在詞彙上專業化。我們在三個跨越97年的時間結構語料庫上評估了該框架：歷史美國英語語料庫、哈佛商業評論和國際勞工評論。相對於共享骨幹，殘差適應改善了語料庫特定的擬合，同時保留了相同索引的跨語料庫主題軌跡，實現了比從同一骨幹進行完全微調更強的對齊，Trajectory Retrieval@1達到$97.5 \pm 0.7\%$，而完全微調則為$17.9 \pm 1.1\%$，同時比獨立訓練加上事後匈牙利匹配的對齊更強。這些結果表明，將主題對齊納入模型可以支持更穩定的隨時間變化的跨語料庫比較，同時保留語料庫特定的詞彙變異。
